long_biography.plain_text:
The William Pears Group began as a family enterprise founded by Bernard Pears and his son Clive in 1952. Its focus moved from commercial development into long-term property investment, later adding financing and joint ventures backed by real assets. David Pears joined the business in 1987, after attending Middlesex University.

David now serves as a board director rather than chief executive; his elder brother Mark holds the chief-executive role, while Trevor leads the family's foundation. Together, the brothers oversee a family-owned platform whose activities include residential and commercial property management, lending and partnership investment. David is also a Pears Foundation trustee. The foundation applies family-business resources to long-term grants and partnerships in Britain and internationally.
